name: Order Limit for WooCommerce – Set Order Restrictions, Min and Max Amount/Quantity, Cart Control, and Checkout Restrictions
author: Xfinitysoft

sections.description:
Set WooCommerce order limits with minimum and maximum quantities, cart totals, and role-based rules. Also, control product, category, and checkout order restrictions with ease.

  • Try the Demo
  • Technical Documentation
  • 👉 Check out the Premium Version
  • Facebook Page

If you run a WooCommerce store, controlling how much customers can order is crucial for managing stock, avoiding overordering, and boosting sales. Order Limit for WooCommerce gives you powerful tools to set minimum and maximum order amounts, product quantity limits, and cart restrictions without complex setups.

Whether you need to restrict checkout in WooCommerce based on order value, create user role-based order limits for wholesalers, or simply enforce a minimum purchase in WooCommerce, this plugin helps you handle it all.

From product-level rules to cart validation, category-based order limits, and payment gateway restrictions, this plugin is built for store owners who want smarter control over how orders are placed.

Isn’t that amazing? Wait until you see its features 😃👇

Powerful Features of Order Limit for WooCommerce

Here’s what you get with this WooCommerce min and max order restriction plugin:

🛒 Product & Category Order Limit Features

  • Product Purchase Limit Control: Set minimum and maximum order quantities or amounts for individual products.
  • Variation-Specific Purchase Restrictions (Pro): Apply unique minimum and maximum order limits to each variation of a variable product.
  • Aggregate Product Rule Combinations: Combine restrictions across selected products for cumulative purchase control.
  • Category-Based Order Limits: Define minimum and maximum purchase restrictions across entire product categories.
  • Aggregate Category Rules: Apply combined restrictions across multiple categories by quantity or value.
  • Exclude Specific Products (Pro): Exempt items like gift cards, subscriptions, or promos — or even assign them their own special purchase cap.
  • Exclude Specific Products from Rules (Pro): Exempt items like gift cards, subscriptions, or promotional products from restrictions.

👥 Customer & User Role Order Restrictions

  • User Role-Based Order Rules (Pro): Create tailored restrictions for wholesalers, retailers, logged-in users, or guest shoppers.
  • Customer-Specific Purchase Limits (Pro): Assign unique order rules to specific customers for tighter control.
  • Guest-Only Restrictions (Pro): Apply special purchase limits for guest checkouts.
  • User Purchase History Limits (Pro): Restrict new orders based on a customer’s past WooCommerce purchases.
  • Storewide Purchase History Control (Pro): Track combined sales across all customers to set total store limits.
  • Real-Time Order Validation (Pro): Instantly verify past orders before allowing checkout.
  • Wholesale Order Flexibility (Pro): Set relaxed order limits for wholesale buyers while applying stricter rules for retail shoppers.
  • Order Status Control (Pro): Choose which order statuses (e.g., Completed, Processing) count toward purchase history limits.

🛍️ Cart & Checkout Restriction Features

  • Cart Total Restrictions: Enforce minimum and maximum cart totals (items or amount) before checkout.
  • Cart Quantity Restrictions: Apply minimum and maximum product quantity rules directly at the cart level.
  • Hide Checkout Button: Prevent checkout until cart or order rules are met.
  • Payment Gateway Restrictions (Pro): Apply purchase restriction rules for specific payment methods such as PayPal, Bank Transfer, or COD.
  • Exclude Shipping Costs (Pro): Ensure order limits are based only on products, not shipping fees.

⏳ Time-Based & Storewide Order Rules

  • Time-Based Reset Rules: Reset order limits daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or on custom intervals.
  • Precise Reset Options: Choose to reset at midnight or from the customer’s last purchase time.
  • Global Order Count Limits (Pro): Limit the total number of orders storewide on flexible schedules.
  • Global Order Value Caps (Pro): Restrict the total revenue across your store over a set period.
  • Store Closure Mode (Pro): Pause all new orders instantly with a one-click storewide block.

💬 Messaging, Alerts & Shortcodes (Free + Pro)

  • Custom Limit Messages: Display personalized warning or error messages to customers when limits are exceeded.
  • Dynamic Message Placeholder Support: Use placeholders such as {store-name}, {max-order-limit}, or {remaining} to make messages clear and dynamic.
  • Advanced Notices (Pro): Customize messages for specific cases — parent products, accumulative rules, or returning customers.
  • Dynamic Quantity Alerts: Show real-time notifications on how many items a customer can still purchase.
  • Shortcodes for Rules & Limits: Display order rules anywhere on your store using simple shortcodes.
  • Remaining Limit Shortcodes: Show remaining product or order allowance with shortcodes like [wc-order-limit-remaining].

🌐 Multi-Vendor Marketplace Compatibility

  • Compatibility with WC Vendors Pro (Pro): Admin can set vendor-specific order limits. Let vendors set their own order limits, share control with admins, or apply global restrictions across vendors.

Compatible with WC Vendors Pro

Our plugin works seamlessly with WC Vendors , giving marketplace admins and vendors full flexibility over order restrictions:

  • Per-Vendor Order Limits: The admin can set individual minimum and maximum limits for each vendor’s products.
  • Admin Control Sharing: The admin can grant vendors permission to adjust their own order restriction settings.
  • Vendor Self-Management: Vendors with access can create or update their own WooCommerce order limits without relying on the site admin.

This makes it the perfect solution for multi-vendor stores that need product quantity limits, cart restrictions, or checkout rules tailored to each vendor.

Free Version

✔ Set min/max order quantities or amounts per product (simple products)
✔ Set min/max purchase restrictions per category
✔ Combine product or category limits for cumulative control

✅ Min/max cart totals (by items or amount) + per-category cart total restrictions, exclude shipping cost from limits

WooCommerce Order Restriction is Ideal for Store Owners Who Want To:

  • Set WooCommerce Minimum Order Amounts: Require customers to spend a specific amount before checkout, helping increase average order value.
  • Apply WooCommerce Maximum Order Quantity Rules: Stop customers from purchasing more than a set number of items, preventing stockouts and abuse during sales.

  • Control Orders by Payment Method: Apply order restrictions to specific payment gateways like COD, PayPal, or bank transfers.
  • Enforce Cart Limits at Checkout: Define cart-level restrictions that encourage larger purchases or stop oversized orders.
  • Automate Inventory Control: Reduce manual oversight with rules that handle stock protection, order caps, and purchase limitations automatically.

Use Cases of This WooCommerce Order Restriction Plugin

Order Limit for WooCommerce isn’t just another min/max plugin—it’s built to solve real problems for different types of online stores. Here are some of the most popular use cases:

  • Retail Stores: Apply a WooCommerce minimum order amount to encourage larger carts, or set maximum order quantities on hot products to prevent hoarding during promotions.
  • Wholesale Businesses: Use role-based order rules to require higher minimum purchases for B2B buyers while keeping retail customers unrestricted.

  • Subscription Services: Limit the number of items per subscriber each week or month, keeping order volume aligned with delivery capacity.

  • Over-Ordering Prevention: Stop bulk or excessive purchases during promotions or when stock is low.
  • Inventory Workflow Automation: Automate minimum and maximum purchase rules to reduce manual oversight.
  • High-Demand or Limited Stock Items: Enforce WooCommerce cart limits to prevent overselling when supply is low.
  • Payment-Based Order Control: Apply restrictions when customers choose certain gateways like COD, PayPal, or Bank Transfer.

sections.installation:
Installation Requirements

To use Order Limit for WooCommerce – Min/Max Quantity & Cart Control, make sure your store meets the following requirements:
* WordPress 4.4.0 or higher
* WooCommerce 5.0.0 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or higher

How to Install Order Limit for WooCommerce

To install the plugin, follow these simple steps:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
2. Go to Plugins → Add Plugin.
3. Search for ‘Order Limit for WooCommerce
4. Look for ‘Order Limit for WooCommerce’ by XfinitySoft.
5. Click Install Now, then Activate.
6. You’ll find WC Order Limit under WooCommerce settings to start creating rules.

No coding required — just pick a rule type (Product, Category, Customer, or Cart) and set your limits.
sections.faq:
Can I set a minimum order amount in WooCommerce?

With this plugin, you can easily set a WooCommerce minimum order amount at the product, category, cart, or store level. Customers won’t be able to checkout until they meet the required total.

Can I set a maximum order quantity for specific products?

Yes. The plugin lets you apply WooCommerce’s maximum order quantity rules to individual products and even to variable products, preventing customers from buying more than allowed.

Does this plugin support variable products?

Absolutely. You can create variation-specific order limits so each variation of a variable product has its own minimum and maximum purchase rules.

Can I restrict orders by customer role in WooCommerce?

Yes, you can set user role-based order limits for wholesalers, retailers, or even guest users. Each role can have unique purchase restrictions.

How do I apply category-based order restrictions?

You can create WooCommerce category-based order limits that apply to all products within a specific category, either by quantity or total order value.

Can I restrict checkout in WooCommerce based on cart total?

Yes. Using the WooCommerce cart limits feature, you can require a minimum or maximum cart value before allowing checkout.

Is it possible to set global order limits for the whole store?

Yes. You can create storewide order rules to cap the total number of orders or the total order value within a given time frame (daily, weekly, monthly).

Can I create time-based purchase restrictions?

Yes. With time-based order rules, you can reset purchase limits daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or on a custom schedule.

Can I apply order restrictions based on payment method?

Yes, you can enforce payment gateway restrictions by limiting orders made with PayPal, COD, bank transfer, or other gateways.

Can I exclude specific products from order limits?

Yes. You can exclude products like gift cards, subscriptions, or promotional items from order restrictions.

Does the plugin show custom messages to customers?

Yes, you can display customized error or warning messages with dynamic placeholders such as {remaining}, {store-name}, or {max-order-limit}.

How do shortcodes work in this plugin?

The plugin includes WooCommerce shortcode support so you can display order rules or remaining purchase limits anywhere on your site.

Can I hide the checkout button until customers meet order requirements?

Yes, the plugin lets you hide the WooCommerce checkout button until the defined order rules are satisfied.

Is this plugin compatible with WC Vendors Pro?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WC Vendors Pro. Admins can set individual vendor limits, grant vendors access to manage their own order rules, and vendors can adjust their limits independently.

Does the plugin work with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes. The plugin is actively maintained, tested with the latest WooCommerce and WordPress versions, and supports most modern themes and plugins.
